verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say notes are stored locally as non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files and that users 'can switch to another app easily', so leaving requires no export step. Canvas uses an MIT-licensed open JSON format. Community users independently confirm file ownership and that notes can outlive the app. Missing for 10: evidence on how portable Obsidian-specific syntax and non-Markdown files (e.g. Bases views, plugin data) are in other apps, given a community note that .canvas JSON is less readable than Markdown.
